plugins.name: multi-reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-agent CROSS-VALIDATION protocol — review-only, NOT for plan/code generation. Use superpowers (brainstorming/writing-plans/TDD) to draft, then return here. 1 main implementer (编码独占) + N reviewers (default 2, configurable 1-26 via init.mjs). Five entry modes (B1-B4 plan review + A QA regression), N-way double-blind, B1 single-reviewer exception, multi-repo single-source prompt. Bootstraps .claude/rules/, enforces archive + double-blind + main-agent-coding-exclusive protocol.
